title: The Borrowed Camera

continued.text: Then she handed him the strap and announced that, since he was paying for the lens anyway, he might as well learn how to use the camera properly.

items.ask: Plan a paragraph: why does Theo tell the truth? Fill in each box.
Write your paragraph. Why does Theo tell the truth? Quote the story twice.

answer_key: 1. Claim: Theo tells the truth because lying feels worse than facing Marisol. · Evidence: "each one made his stomach tighten a little more" · Explanation: His guilt grows with every excuse, so honesty is the only relief.

2. Sample: Theo tells the truth because he cannot live with his own excuses. All evening he invents lies, but "each one made his stomach tighten a little more." His body reacts to every lie before anyone else hears it. He also knows how hard Marisol worked, since she saved "for almost a year" to buy the camera. That knowledge makes a lie feel even worse. In the end, confessing is the only way Theo can feel at peace. Full answer: Claim: one clear reason Theo confesses. Evidence: two exact quotes, such as his stomach tightening and Marisol saving for a year. Explanation: how each quote shows his guilt growing.
